description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter on your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.
The region ID of the service instance.

description.en:
The ID of the service instance.

Call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to obtain the service instance ID.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请您确保在创建服务时添加了开机、关机的运维操作。具体操作，请参见[创建服务](~~440268~~)。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Ensure that you configured the startup and shutdown operations and maintenance (O\&M) when you created the service. For more information, see [Create a service](~~440268~~).
